scripts/run_comparison.py.name: Side-by-side report
scripts/run_comparison.py.description: Runs the saved variations and writes the comparison table, with the wave behaviour included.

scripts/run_optimisation_report.py.name: Best battery position report
scripts/run_optimisation_report.py.description: Runs the battery sweep over both possible zones and writes the ranked result with the plots.

scripts/run_verification.py.name: Checking the model against the drawings
scripts/run_verification.py.description: Checks the simulation against the reference drawings: volumes, dimensions, left-right symmetry and whether the answers settle.

scripts/verification_md.py.name: Verification report, readable
scripts/verification_md.py.description: Turns the raw verification results into a report a person can read.
